summary: Frontend-only testing of Ledger match/needs-matching UI (revenue + payables). Seeded 2 sales invoices (TEST-A-71 10k, TEST-B-71 8k), 1 unmatched IN payment (15k), 1 purchase_bill (TEST-PB-71 6k), 1 unmatched OUT payment (4k). Verified: searchable InvoicePicker filters correctly on both sides; overpayment leftover behavior (15k → INV_A 10k paid + 5k leftover STAYS in needs-matching with '₹5,000 · ₹10,000 already applied'); leftover 5k matched to INV_B (partial) then item removed; Expenses tab payables-needs-matching panel present; OUT 4k matched to purchase bill removed from panel with success toast 'Payment matched'; regression KPIs (Overview: Revenue/Spend/Net Profit; Revenue tab: Billed/Received/Outstanding) all render; invoice chips 'received' and 'partial' visible. All test scenarios PASSED.
critical_code_review_comments: Ledger.js is 938 lines — approaching >700 line threshold; consider splitting NeedsMatchingPanel/InvoicePicker/RevenueTab/ExpensesTable into separate files for maintainability.
Pre-existing demo noise: 6x INV-2045 duplicate invoices in Sharma demo tenant (already flagged by AI brief; harmless for this feature).
seed_data_creation: Seeded via /app/test_reports/seed_iter71.py (tag=TEST_ITER71); cleaned up after run (3 invoices + 2 payments removed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: InvoicePicker is a custom button+list (NOT native select). Toggle via [data-testid='match-picker-<pid>-toggle'], then fill search [data-testid='match-picker-<pid>-search'], then click option [data-testid='match-picker-<pid>-opt-<invId>']. Overview tab is default at /ledger — must click Revenue tab to see ledger-revenue panel. Seed via db.invoices (type=sales_invoice or purchase_bill) and db.payments (direction=in/out with match_status='unmatched', applied=0, applications=[]).
rca of the issue: N/A — all features work as specified.
